data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002 abstracts SRC_005 by replacing the sequential positional constraint (9 choices for hundreds, 9 for tens, 8 for units) with the universal set-theoretic principle of complement subtraction. This abstraction is refuted if the positional product 9*9*8 does not evaluate to the set-theoretic difference 900-252, proving the abstraction fails to capture the same combinatorial object.
